items: Ways to take part are now five named routes rather than four generic ones: present, pitch, attend, exhibit and teach. Abstract became present. The hands-on pre-congress courses at IPEG and EUPSA were sitting under exhibit and are now their own teach route.

Every route now carries a cost with a source link, and a basis flag saying whether the figure is published for this edition, carried over from the previous edition, approximate, free or simply not published.
HealthTech Innovation Days 2026 is confirmed for 1 October 2026 in Paris. It was previously logged as an estimate of early to mid October.
The MedTech Forum 2027 is confirmed for 10 to 11 May 2027 in Rome. The host city was previously unannounced.
Georgia Tech Pediatric Innovation Day ran on 7 July 2026, so the record was pointing at a date that had already passed. It now tracks the 2027 cycle.
APSA 2027 call for abstracts is still not posted, which now makes it more than a year late against the 2026 pattern. Checked again 26 Aug 2026.
MedTech Innovator 2027 applications have still not opened. The 2026 cohort closed and only a waitlist is live.

New routes added: attend and teach for APSA 2027, attend for IPEG 2027 and EUPSA 2027, a pre-conference course route for IMSH 2027, a pre-congress course for jENS 2027, exhibitor tier for the Nationwide Children's robotic surgery course, and visitor entry for MEDICA 2026.
jENS 2027 abstracts: the 31 March date is 2027, not 2026. Submission opened 21 July 2026 and closes 31 March 2027, so this is open now.
IMSH 2027 Call for Content closed 27 May 2026. The SimVentors Showcase is 25 January 2027 and excludes commercially available technologies.
SWPDC and AAP SOATT prize: the consortium states eligibility is limited to devices going through the FDA regulatory pathway. 2026 round still unannounced.
UCSF-Stanford PDC: the accelerator is stated as restricted to US-based applicants. Award size is up to 100K USD, not 50K. Runs twice a year.
MedTech Innovator: the 2026 cohort closed 1 December 2025, earlier than the 16 December recorded. The window has moved earlier two years running.
MEDICA competitions confirmed at 10 September 2026, 23:59 CET. MEDICA states no MDR or FDA conformity is required to enter.
IPEG 2027 confirmed as 27 to 30 April in Naples, in collaboration with ESPES and SICP. Abstract details still pending.
APSA 2027 call not yet posted. The 2026 guide appeared in August of the preceding year, so it is due imminently.
First build of the radar from the tracker sheet: 29 events, 62 ways to participate.
Deadline status computed live against today's date rather than typed by hand.
